messages:
nora: small but important: onboarding tutorial uses parallel fetch of many cursors which is making customers hit rate limits if token refresh occurs mid-run. getting some angry PM emails.
josh: is this the same as RE-3211? sounds related.
nora: similar, but this is the browser quickstart where users do Promise.all on cursors returned from a search. they copy the code verbatim.
reliability-bot: detected spike in 429s from quickstart-apps region-us-west-2 at 2026-02-14T16:20:00Z; correlated with new signups.
devrel: can we change the quickstart sample to use a built-in PaginationHelper with concurrency default 1 and backpressure on 429? quick win: change docs + educate that browsers should be conservative.
sam: PaginationHelper idea sounds good. Should support: serialize option, concurrency limit, automatic expansion/contract on 429s, and preserve resume token ordering.
josh: for the SDK we should: implement single-flight token refresh in browser SDK, provide an optional in-flight dedupe toggle, and include a sample PaginationHelper in the dev-examples repo.
nora: also request: make the quickstart include a note about client-side vs server-side pagination pros/cons (don't do heavy parallel fetch from browser).
devrel: i'll update the quickstart PR. Also adding a note to release notes: "Quickstart reduces default page fetch concurrency to 1 due to token refresh and rate limit behavior".
sam: one more edge case  if a page fetch is retried and the cursor advanced in the backend, retries can fetch the next cursor and cause gap/dup issues. our pagination helper should track sequence numbers or use idempotency tokens at the backend layer.
josh: we should discuss adding a small server-side change: if request has x-client-page-seq header, the backend can return 409 if seq mismatch so client can resync. low priority, but worth engineering discussion.
reliability-bot: monitoring alert: after lowering quickstart concurrency, 429s dropped 67% in the next hour.
reliability-bot: marking incident resolved.
nora: thanks team. can we prioritize a small stable fix in SDK before the next onboarding cohort?
sam: will follow up with PR for browser auth single-flight and helper.
